verdict: Campaign paused mid-flight with only 2 leads captured — spend is stalling right as demand peaks.
diagnosis: You spent $5,479 this period and generated 2 leads at $12.03 each, while the main call campaign sits paused.

signals.headline: Only 2 leads from $5,479 spend
signals.detail: Lead volume is critically low this period. Cost per lead of $12 looks cheap, but the sample is too small to trust.

signals.headline: 9 purchases worth $5,897 tracked
signals.detail: Purchase revenue nearly matched ad spend this period. Return on ad spend of roughly 1.08x means you barely broke even.

signals.headline: Call campaign paused during peak season
signals.detail: The retargeting call campaign is off. For a phone-driven medical alert product, this is likely your biggest revenue leak right now.

signals.headline: Only 1 call click this period
signals.detail: Google Business Profile drove essentially zero phone calls. For a product sold via (800) number, this channel is dormant.

signals.headline: 138 landing page views, 22 add-to-carts
signals.detail: Roughly 16% of visitors added to cart but only 9 purchased. Checkout friction is likely leaving money on the table.

benchmark.label: Benchmark
benchmark.subheader: Wellness cost per lead sits near $98
benchmark.body: <cite index="3-13">Business-to-consumer healthcare cost per lead ranges from $98 for wellness to $661 for facilities in 2026.</cite> Your $12 cost per lead beats the benchmark, but volume is too small to celebrate.

seasonal.label: Seasonal
seasonal.subheader: Healthcare lead costs climbed sharply in July
seasonal.body: <cite index="2-1">Healthcare cost per lead on Facebook rose from $47 in July 2025 to $104 in July 2026, more than doubling.</cite> Expect rising click prices through late summer.

competitor.label: Competitor
competitor.body: <cite index="10-1">Wearable alert systems like smartwatches and pendants saw adoption jump 45% thanks to real-time tracking and fall detection.</cite> Your Medical Alert Watch fits this shift — lean into it.

recommendations.title: Reactivate the paused call campaign
recommendations.detail: The retargeting call campaign is off. Consider turning it back on with a small daily cap to test whether phone leads return at a workable cost.

recommendations.title: Fix the add-to-cart to purchase gap
recommendations.detail: 22 carts produced 9 purchases this period. Worth reviewing checkout, shipping costs, and trust signals before spending more on top-of-funnel traffic.

recommendations.title: Test wearable-focused creative for adult children
recommendations.detail: Adult children buy for aging parents. Consider testing ads that emphasize fall detection and discreet wearable design — the top requested features in 2026.
